title: Sr Engr Cslt-Data Science
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**Sr\_Engr\_Cslt\_Data\_Science**
The Data, AI and Analytics Organization is an exciting center of excellence supporting all of Verizon as a part of the Transformation Office.
  
  
You’ll work closely with a team of Business Stakeholders, Data scientists, data engineers, and Software developers to play a key role in developing and delivering the solutions that generate substantial value for the business.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* We use digital data as the fuel to propel us beyond our competition. As a Sr Engr Cslt Data Scientist, you’ll contribute to projects that develop and perform complex analyses using Agentic AI solutions and Big Data technologies to solve critical business problems. You’ll be constantly on the lookout for new modeling techniques through agents, evolving technologies, and emerging industry trends so that we can stay ahead of the game. Your work will help us meet our customers’ needs and make it even easier for them to do business with us.
* You'll be part of a leading-edge advanced analytics team required to build optimized agents to improve supply chain management and drive optimal decisions in some of the world’s most unique supply chain and business operations problems. The advanced analytics team develops Agentic solutions for stock out management, geospatial routings and mathematical models to support Verizon’s supply chain and operations business objectives. Our team leverages tools like agentic solutions, big data, statistical analysis, machine learning, optimization methods, and related analytical techniques.
* As a team member you will:

+ Develop agentic solutions for better optimized performance of the models after a deep understanding of the business context and objectives of the projects you support.
+ Develop models for agentic framework, optimized solutions and model building
+ Actionable insights, optimized data handling solutions and visual dashboards.
+ Conduct through the development and implementation of actionable analytics products through agentic framework
+ Ensure data quality and promote process improvement.
+ Learn and understand the business processes of supply chain and operations. Learn the tradeoffs and priorities of the business.
+ Translate supply chain and operations into analytical problems and effectively communicate results and business implications to key stakeholders.
+ Partner with team and non-team data scientists to assess project feasibility, select input features, validate project output, and communicate the key results.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* With an eye towards improving performance and predictability, you like the science of analytics. Developing resolutions to complex problems, using your sharp judgment to develop methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria allows you to deliver solutions that make a huge impact.
* Provides support for model build and layouts for complex, large-scale data sets used for modeling, data mining, and research purposes. Supports the building of large and complex data sets from spurious sources while thinking strategically about uses of data and how data use interacts with data design.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
* Experience in agentic framework, data scientist, analyst, or statistical modeler.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs programmatically (e.g., Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI).
* Experience designing and building autonomous or semi-autonomous systems using Agentic Frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google ADK).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Degree in data science, business intelligence and analytics, computer science, or mathematics.
* Master’s degree in a technical field like Operations Research, Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or an engineering or scientific discipline.
* Knowledge on Supply chain mgmt, stock mgmt, retail functions
* Experience with Agentic AI, Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform Services.
* Practical experience with Enterprise LangGraph SDK or Google ADK.
* Production AI Engineering: Good knowledge of RAG Architecture, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI Observability/Tracing, and scaling production-grade agentic solutions.
* Experience with programming languages, like Java, Python, or R.
* Experience with Alteryx.
* Experience with SQL.
* Experience with visualization tools, like Tableau, looker or similar visual analysis tools, optimization, analytics and large data sets, developing visually compelling interactive dashboards.
* Experience leveraging AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to accelerate daily development workflows while maintaining a disciplined approach to model selection and token efficiency.

**Additional Job Description**

* Works with key stakeholders to generate hypotheses and create orchestrator agent and analytic models that answer impactful business questions. Responsible for leading the design and implementation of data science products leveraging complex, large-scale data sets while thinking strategically about uses of data and how the developed models meet the goals of the business. Develops resolutions to complex problems that require the use of creativity and makes decisions that impact projects and staff members.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What you’ll be doing** 
 ...
   

  

 As a Consultant (Analytics) you will be a pivotal player in modernizing telecom financial operations. Bridging the gap between implementation and architectural strategy, you will design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions tailored for the finance domain. Your work will transition complex financial workflows—such as Forecasting as a Service, Explainability framework, Funnel Forecasting, Customer Profitability etc., and also performing analyses that impact Bad Debt, Cash flow, Credit Score cut models, etc., among others—into automated, intelligent, and proactive systems.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of critical AI models while translating complex technical results into compelling business narratives for finance leadership.
   

  

* Design and deploy core AI/ML and Generative AI solutions to optimize financial operations.
* Build and orchestrate Agentic AI workflows to automate multi\-step financial analysis and decision\-making processes.
* Utilize foundational models and AI assistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to rapidly prototype, iterate, and deliver agile AI solutions to meet dynamic business needs.
* Engineer robust data pipelines and write complex SQL/BigQuery queries to extract and transform large\-scale financial datasets using GCP and Python.
* Act as a data storyteller—synthesizing complex AI/ML model outputs into clear, actionable, and prescriptive insights for non\-technical finance stakeholders.
* Design, develop, and optimize Artificial Intelligence, NLP, SLM/LLM solutions to diverse real\-world problems.
* Implement MLOps best practices to ensure continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring of financial AI models in production environments.
* Driving data\-derived insights across the business domain by developing advanced statistical models, machine learning algorithms and computational algorithms based on business initiatives.


**What We’re Looking For...**
 Your primary focus will be transforming traditional financial operations into a proactive, AI\-driven organization. You are a hands\-on builder who thrives at the intersection of core ML, cutting\-edge GenAI, and business strategy. You have a knack for rapid prototyping and possess the communication skills required to explain the "why" and "how" of AI to business leaders.
   

  

**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field
* Three or more years of relevant professional work experience.
* Three or more years of experience practicing data science, AI engineering, or machine learning, with a strong focus on core AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic frameworks.
* Experience with all phases of end\-to\-end Analytics project, such as (but not limited to): Ingestion, Munging, Model Building, Validation, Operationalization, Monitoring
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and advanced SQL.
* Proven experience working within cloud platforms (Teradata/ GCP) and using tools like BigQuery for large\-scale data processing.
* Demonstrated experience in rapid prototyping and building solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot).
* Hands\-on familiarity with specific Agentic AI and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex).
* Exceptional data storytelling and communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into confident financial business decisions.


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Advanced degree (Master’s) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Prior experience in the telecommunications industry specifically dealing with financial data, billing systems, FinOps, revenue assurance.
* Experience in designing and deploying end\-to\-end MLOps and LLMOps pipelines.
* A strong understanding of financial forecasting models, anomaly detection algorithms, and time\-series analysis.

We create an opportunity for us all to share in the success of Verizon and the value we help to create through this broad\-based discretionary equity award program.

* You are provided with a full spectrum of health and wellbeing resources, including a first in\-class Employee Assistance Program, to empower you to make positive health decisions.

 The APAC Business Technology Team within Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking an
 **AI Solution Lead** 
 to design, build, and deploy scalable AI, GenAI, and data science solutions that improve commercial effectiveness, customer engagement, and business decision\-making.
   

  

 This role will partner closely with Business, Commercial Excellence, Marketing, and Technology teams to translate business problems into practical AI\-enabled solutions. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on technical capability in AI/ML, GenAI, data science, and cloud\-based delivery with strong business partnership skills and the ability to drive solutions from concept to deployment.

**Tasks/Duties/Responsibilities**

* Translate business objectives into analytical and technical requirements with clear success metrics such as adoption, time saved, accuracy, quality, reliability, cost, or business impact.
* Communicate solution options, trade\-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with product owners, data engineers, architects, and vendors to deliver end\-to\-end AI solutions.

* Stay current with the latest advancements in Generative AI, cloud technologies, and LLMOps practices, and proactively translate relevant insights into team and platform adoption.
* Evaluate emerging tools, techniques, and methodologies to enhance GenAI capabilities, developer productivity, and operational efficiency, integrating them into platforms and solutions where they add value.
* Lead targeted experimentation and proofs of concept, scaling successful ideas into robust, production\-ready solution

* 3\+ years of experience building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production environments.
* Experience delivering solutions across the full lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.


**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Experience designing scalable AI solution architectures across cloud, data, model, and application layers.
* Hands\-on experience designing, building, deploying, and operating GenAI/agentic AI solutions including tool calling/orchestration, model evaluation, and monitoring frameworks.
* Understanding of Responsible AI, model governance, privacy, security, and enterprise risk management principles.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and workflow systems.

* Practical experience with cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, Azure, AWS, Azure ML, or AWS Bedrock.
* Experience with software engineering and DevOps practices such as Git, CI/CD, testing, APIs, containerisation, workflow orchestration, and production deployment.
* Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; experience with PySpark or distributed data processing frameworks preferred.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical or technical solutions.

* Ability to work in a matrixed, cross\-functional environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong ownership mindset, and problem\-solving ability.

title: Sr. Engineer - Data Engineering
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in Snowflake and dbt to design, build, and optimize scalable cloud data solutions. The ideal candidate will have expertise in developing ELT pipelines, dimensional/data modeling, SQL optimization, and implementing reliable data transformation frameworks using dbt. The role requires close collaboration with data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver high\-quality, governed, and performant data products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models using Snowflake and dbt.
* Build reusable and maintainable dbt models, macros, tests, snapshots, and incremental models.
* Develop complex SQL transformations and optimize Snowflake queries for performance and cost.
* Design data models following dimensional modeling and modern data warehouse best practices.
* Implement automated data\-quality checks, testing, documentation, and lineage using dbt.
* Work with Snowflake features including warehouses, databases/schemas, stages, streams/tasks, roles, and access controls.
* Troubleshoot data pipeline failures, performance issues, and data\-quality problems.
* Participate in code reviews and establish engineering standards for SQL and dbt development.
* Collaborate with upstream/downstream teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable datasets.
* Support CI/CD and automated deployment processes for dbt projects across environments.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake.
* Strong hands\-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tool).
* Advanced SQL and strong understanding of query optimization.
* Experience designing and implementing ELT/data transformation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and SCD concepts.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD development practices.
* Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
* Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Experience with dbt Cloud, including jobs, environments, deployments, and CI.
* Familiarity with Snowflake security, RBAC, performance tuning, and cost optimization.


**Ideal Experience:** 
 5\+ years in Data Engineering, including significant hands\-on experience with Snowflake and dbt.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Associate Director Data Science
description:
The purpose of this role is to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that improve pipeline and launch forecasts and enable confident strategic and operational decisions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Develop and maintain predictive models, statistical analyses, and machine learning applications to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Analyze complex datasets and turn the findings into clear recommendations for business teams.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to understand business challenges and define analytical approaches that support strategic objectives.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics to enable effective monitoring of key business outcomes.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across analytical models, reporting processes, and data sources.
* Communicate analytical findings and insights clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences to support informed decision\-making.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, analytics capabilities, and data science best practices within the organization. Use data and advanced analytics to improve forecasts and support commercial decisions.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* University Degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics or economy or similar field of study
* 7\+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, business intelligence or a related field.
* Experience working with commercial or sales forecasting is highly desirable.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, and life sciences is an advantage.
* Experience and ability to work with large datasets, preferably with Python or R. Knowledge of machine learning techniques, predictive analytics, and statistical modeling.
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Python, or R visualization libraries.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based analytics platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) is preferred. Understanding of generative AI and advanced analytics applications is a plus.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

  

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
